critical_code_review_comments: staff_onboarding_wizard.py is now 2046 lines (previously flagged at 1880). URGENT to split into sub-routers (cases/invites/offer/contract/portal/docs) — well past the 700-line guideline.
StaffOnboarding.js frontend continues to grow; DocsManager inside PackSettings should be its own component file to keep the Settings modal maintainable.

_slugify collisions: if HR renames a policy to the same title as an existing one, the new key clashes and the PUT will overwrite the wrong doc. Consider appending a short uuid suffix if key already exists in the org.

No max-file-size guard on POST /staff-onboarding/{kind}/{key}/upload — a 100 MB PDF would be read entirely into memory + sent to the LLM. Add a size ceiling (e.g. 10 MB) + reject non-PDF types with a 415 rather than silently skipping AI.
DELETE /api/staff-onboarding/cases/{id} still missing (405) — flagged in previous iteration; blocks test cleanup.
